messages.author: 9349b31ec7c243b2
messages.subject: Re: googleVis and html
parts:
Here's the simple answer -- should have read the manual before posting:

in server.R
  output$plot3 <- renderGvis({
    gvisLineChart(action3,xvar="WS",yvar=a.str[2:17])
  })

in index.html
<div id="plot3" class="shiny-html-output" style="width: 100%; height: 400px"></div>

your variable names might be different of course.
